feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 16 May 2026 4:11pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 16 May 2026 at 4:10pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind in places overnight.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland, with an associated frontal zone clearing the Irish Sea this evening.


##Wind##

South or southwest 2 to 4, veering west 4 or 5 this evening, then occasionally increasing 6 in places tonight. Backing southwest tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Slight, soon becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle clearing eastwards this evening, then mainly fair overnight and tomorrow morning, showers spreading from west during the afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, veering west or southwest 3 or 4, then backing south 4 or 5 late in the period.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate at first and again late in the period.


##Weather##

Showers, becoming isolated.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
